t: Wera 335/350/355/6 Kraftform Plus 6 screwdriver set with rack. Kraftform Plus handle has been designed to fit perfectly into the hand to allow for fast, comfortable and ergonomic screwdriving. The handle hard zones glide across the hand for high working speeds, while soft zones provide grip to ensure high torque transfer and comfort during intensive use. Hexagonal anti-roll feature prevents any unwanted rolling. Lasertip technology, on the screwdriver tip, bites into the screwhead to prevent slipping.
b: Contents: 2 x 350 PH screwdrivers (PH1 x 80 and PH2 x 100mm), 2 x 355 PZ screwdrivers (PZ1 x 80 and PZ2 x 100mm) and 2 x 335 slotted screwdrivers (0.8 x 4.0 x 100 and 1 x 5.5 x 125mm).
